metadata.scenario_context: Emily is preparing to move into a new home and is planning to host a housewarming party. One of her neighbors have heavy drinkers . Mike and Kim will attend Emily’s housewarming party.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from China would like to have heavy drinkers as neighbors.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Australia would not like to have heavy drinkers as neighbors.

agent_1.goal_1: Discuss bringing chrysanthemums to Emily’s housewarming party
agent_1.goal_2: Question whether would like to have heavy drinkers as a neighbor.

agent_2.goal_1: Decide appropriate gift to bring to Emily’s housewarming party.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss on whether it’s acceptable to have heavy drinkers  as a neighbor.

shared_prefix.speaker: Mike
shared_prefix.message:
Hey Kim, have you thought about bringing something to Emily's housewarming party? I was thinking maybe some chrysanthemums would be nice. 

Also... do you think having heavy drinkers as neighbors is a bad thing? I mean, I kind of like it.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Kim
shared_prefix.message:
I was thinking maybe a nice plant or maybe some wine would be good. Chrysanthemums are a bit... boring, don’t you think? 

As for heavy drinkers, I really don’t see that as a good thing. I mean, it can lead to all sorts of issues. You know, noise, mess... just not the kind of vibe I’d want around.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Mike
shared_prefix.message:
I get that you think chrysanthemums are boring, but they symbolize happiness and longevity. They can be a good touch for a new home. 

About the heavy drinkers... I don’t know. I feel like they can add some excitement. People just want to have fun, right?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Kim
shared_prefix.message:
I get your point about chrysanthemums bringing good vibes, and it’s nice to add a touch of happiness to a new home. But, you know, when you really get to know people, they're pretty much like us. 

As for the heavy drinkers, I think the fun can quickly turn into chaos. Sure, excitement is great, but we all want a peaceful environment, right? At the end of the day, we just want to enjoy our homes and feel comfortable.
shared_prefix.label: Minimization

turns.speaker: Mike

turns.label: Minimization

positive.mediator_utterance: Let’s take a step back.
